name: Shirase Emily
source:
A young girl in high school uniform with blond hair and blue eyes. A half-Japanese, half-American, Emily meets Hiroki on the ferry that heading to the island—saying that she's on her way to Ogasawara, which has a special place in her parents' hearts.

"There's something I need to get back. Something precious that sank into the ocean years ago."

[Edited from [url=http://moenovel.com/adventure-of-a-lifetime]English official Site[/url]]
